affected_system: roadway, bridge, sidewalk, signal, and public right-of-way asset network
alternatives: advance high-risk work within verified feasible windows for road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule
use rolling risk and capacity updates to reschedule road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule
pair condition-, dependency-, traffic-, weather-, and crew-aware scheduling with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Assets, inspections, defects, work orders, costs, traffic, restrictions, and completion are reconciled.
Engineering thresholds and deterioration models are locally reviewed and versioned.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue the fixed operating calendar for road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule.

constraints.description: The road and bridge asset management schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public works asset manager and chief infrastructure engineer
decision_question: When should inspections and treatments occur given condition, traffic, weather, dependencies, and permits?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The road and bridge asset management schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
independence_key.decision_object: road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: condition-, dependency-, traffic-, weather-, and crew-aware scheduling

intended_claim: A versioned schedule design for comparing declared alternatives affecting road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in high-consequence asset-days beyond treatment thresholds
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a scheduled inspection or treatment completed or the asset safe.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for road and bridge inspection and maintenance schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.

title: Schedule inspections, maintenance, and construction windows
transportability_risks: Materials, climate, loading, standards, inspection, procurement, and unit costs differ.
Service requests can reveal workload but not structural condition or safety.
